name: UI Quality Check
description: Automatically checks UI component changes for premium quality standards

then.prompt: Review the edited file for premium UI/UX quality. Check: 1) Are theme tokens used consistently (no hardcoded colors)? 2) Are touch targets ≥ 44x44px? 3) Are animations using spring physics or timing presets? 4) Is haptic feedback included for interactions? 5) Are loading/error/empty states handled? 6) Is accessibility considered (labels, contrast)? Provide specific feedback on any issues found.
